item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:
The Sudanese army is advancing into Rapid Support Forces strongholds in West Kordofan and the Blue Nile, while RSF drone strikes have killed at least 1,630 civilians at markets, hospitals and fuel sites. Amnesty International has called for war crimes investigations into the attacks on El Obeid. Courts have sentenced RSF chief Hemedti and 13 others to death in absentia, and a separate court also sentenced the RSF head to death in absentia. RSF commanders and troops are defecting to join the Sudanese army, and external powers supplying drones and technology are being held responsible for civilian deaths. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
